name: Houmonsha
source:
The story begins on a sunny sunday afternoon when a woman visits the apartment of the protagonist, who lives alone. The unique thing about this game is that the relationship between the woman and the protagonist is not decided at this point, and the story that follows will change in three major ways depending on the player's choices.

<Choices>
　1. The girlfriend he started dating two weeks ago
　2. The call girl he just ordered on the phone
　3. A junior colleague from his part-time job.

For example, if you choose the girlfriend you just started dating, you can have sex with her for the first time. If you choose the call girl, you have to do your best to get her to have sex with you. If you choose the junior colleague from your part-time job, you can take advantage of the fact that she has feelings for you and try some slightly abnormal play...

In this way, the situation changes depending on your choices in this multi-adventure game.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/21687/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
故事开始于一个阳光明媚的周日下午，一名女子拜访了独居主人公的公寓。这款游戏的独特之处在于，女性和主角之间的关系此时尚未确定，接下来的故事将根据玩家的选择在三个主要方面发生变化。

<选择>
　1.他两周前开始约会的女朋友2.他刚刚通过电话订购的应召女郎3. 一位兼职的初级同事。

例如，如果你选择刚刚开始约会的女朋友，你可以与她第一次发生性关系。如果你选择应召女郎，你就必须尽最大努力让她和你发生性关系。如果你选择了打工的初级同事，你可以趁着她对你有感情，尝试一些稍微不正常的玩法……

这样，在这款多冒险游戏中，情况会根据你的选择而变化。
